questions.title: A few questions about your new website.
questions.body: This takes about fifteen minutes. Rough answers are fine, and “not sure yet” is a good answer too. Your answers are saved as you go, so you can stop and come back to this link at any time.

questions.title: First, a little about you.
Who is our main point of contact?
What is the best email for them?
And a phone number?
What name should the website use for the business?
questions.body: Your trading name, if it differs from your company name.

questions.title: Who buys from you?
questions.body: Choose as many as apply.

questions.title: Do trade customers get different prices or their own accounts?
Can customers visit you in person?
options: Not yet, but a showroom is planned

questions.title: Where is it, and when is it open?

in: Not yet, but a showroom is planned

questions.title: What should the website do for you?
questions.body: Tap them from most to least important.

questions.title: Which websites do you like, and why?
questions.body: Tile shops, competitors or anything else. Links are perfect.

questions.title: Now, what you sell.
questions.body: This tells us the most about how big the site will be.

questions.title: Roughly how many tile designs will be on the site?
questions.body: Count each design once, even if it comes in several sizes or colours.

questions.title: Do most designs come in several sizes, finishes or colours?
What else do you sell besides tiles?
Where does your product information live today?
questions.body: Names, sizes, prices and so on.
options: Xero, MYOB or other accounting software

questions.title: Can you share a sample of your product list or a catalogue?
questions.body: Anything that shows what information you have.

questions.title: What photos do you have of your products?
options: Our own product and room photos
None yet; we will need photography

questions.title: What should each product page show?
questions.body: Choose as many as apply.

questions.title: How customers will use the site.
How should customers buy?

options.label: They pay online, at a checkout
They ask for a quote, and we follow up
Some products online, the rest by quote
They browse, then call or visit us

questions.title: How will orders reach customers?
Where will you deliver?
Should the site show how much stock you have?
questions.body: Kept up to date automatically, this usually means connecting to your stock system.

questions.title: Which of these would you like?
questions.body: Choose as many as apply.
options: A calculator for how many tiles to buy
Seeing tiles in a photo of a room

questions.title: Which languages should the site be in?
options: English and both kinds of Chinese

questions.title: Who will translate the content?
options: We would like you to arrange it

questions.title: How the site looks and reads.
Do you have a logo and brand?
options: Yes, a logo and brand guidelines
No, we need help with that too

questions.title: Please share your logo and anything else about your brand.

in: Yes, a logo and brand guidelines

questions.title: Do you already own a web address (domain)?
questions.body: A .com.au address needs an ABN.

questions.title: What is it?
Do you need business email set up?
questions.body: For example, sales@yourbusiness.com.au.

questions.title: Besides products, which pages do you need?
questions.body: Choose as many as apply.

questions.title: Who will write the words for the site?
Looking after the site.
Who will add products and change prices after launch?
How comfortable is your team updating a website?
Would you like the site built on a particular platform?
What would you like ongoing help with?
questions.body: Choose as many as apply.

questions.title: Bringing customers to the site.
questions.body: We can talk these through in detail later.

questions.title: Would you like help bringing customers to the site?
questions.body: Through search engines, advertising or both.

questions.title: Which of these interest you?
questions.body: Choose as many as apply.

questions.title: Is your business listed on Google Maps yet?
Which parts of Sydney matter most to you?
Roughly, what could you spend on marketing each month?
questions.body: Including the cost of the ads themselves.

questions.title: Last of all, money and dates.
Roughly, what is the budget for building the site?
questions.body: Not counting ongoing costs. A rough figure helps us suggest the right option.

questions.title: Is there a date the site has to be live by?
questions.body: A showroom opening, for example.

questions.title: When is it?
Who else will help make decisions about the site?
Is there anything else we should know?
questions.placeholder: Take all the room you need

submit.title: That’s everything.
submit.body: Swipe back to review, or send your answers to us now.
submit.label: Send

outro.title: Thank you.
outro.body: We have everything we need from {{customer}} for now. We will be in touch soon with a quote.
